rules.detail: Outside rentals may reach Leh but not tour Nubra, Pangong or Hanle. Enforced by the local rental cooperative; no government order found. Own motorcycles are fine with papers.

rules.detail: Within about 22 kilometres of Hanle, vehicle high beams are to be prohibited and outdoor lighting limited. The reserve boundary has been notified; the notification itself was not found.

gaps: No yearly opening or closing dates found for Chang La or the Chushul to Hanle road for any of the last five years.
The notification of the Hanle Dark Sky Reserve boundary was not found, nor whether the high-beam rule is enforced on the road.
No official source found for which circuits must be chosen on the fee form.
No official source found on whether foreign citizens may visit Chushul or Hanle; blog pages contradict each other.
No written order found for army check posts turning travellers back.
The alternative track over Kaksang La is higher than Chang La; it is not on the listed route and its altitude comes from a blog only.
No government order found for the restriction on rental motorcycles from outside Ladakh.
No official page states the Ladakh tourist fee amounts, so they are left out.
Usual days comes from an operator guide for Leh, Hanle and Tso Moriri; no source gives a figure for the full loop with Pangong.
Video filming dates are not stated; they were published on 22 July 2025 and 12 November 2025. The second uses a track through Chumur that is not on the listed route.
Some stretch distances are doubtful. The open map may not know the road riders use, so the routing service went the long way round.
